summary: MedTech Fixaters is an AI-powered, multi-tenant healthcare platform for clinics and hospitals in India. It connects hospital administration, private doctor workspaces, QR-code appointment booking, live OPD token queues, digital prescriptions and an inbuilt patient CRM in one system, with each hospital's data isolated using PostgreSQL row-level security.

routes.description: QR appointment booking, live patient queues and digital prescriptions for clinics and hospitals in India. Book a free demo of MedTech Fixaters.
routes.h1: Run your OPD without the crowd.
routes.lead: Patients book by scanning your QR code and follow their turn on their phone. Doctors prescribe in seconds. Patients need no app and any phone works, every doctor gets a separate login, and every clinic gets its own QR code and booking link.

routes.title: How It Works | MedTech Fixaters OPD & Queue Software
routes.description: How MedTech Fixaters works for patients, doctors and hospital admins: QR booking, live queue tracking, consultations with patient history, prescriptions and follow-ups.
routes.h1: From the QR code at reception to the prescription on their phone
sections: Getting set up: sign up, add departments and doctors, print your QR code
For patients: scan the QR code, book with the AI assistant or directly, fill in details once, get a token and track the live queue, get called in, receive the prescription on the phone
For doctors: open your workspace, run the live queue, consult with the patient history on screen, write the prescription from your medicine library, set a follow-up and call the next patient
For hospital admins: hospital dashboard, every live queue, doctors, departments and roles, hospital QR, reports and analytics, team chat, activity log
What happens to the data: each hospital is separate, access by role, prescriptions kept as issued
